```{r include=FALSE}
#| label: setup
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.height = 8,
  dev = c("png", "svg"),
  dpi = 200,
  fig.width = 5,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  cache = TRUE,
  cache.extra = 42
)

library(metR)
library(lubridate)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(rcdo)
library(tagger)
library(patchwork)
future::plan("multisession", workers = parallelly::availableCores(omit = 1))

cdo_cache_set(here::here("data/temp/cache"))
cdo_options_set("-L")

box::use(R / datasets[...])
box::use(R / functions[...])
box::use(R / integration[evolve])

source(here::here("R/ggplot.R"))
set_theme()

range_tanaka <- c(0.01, 0.2)


# Prepend a number to each figure.
knitr::opts_hooks$set(label = function(options) {
  this_label <- knitr::opts_current$get("label")

  all_chunks <- knitr::all_labels(startsWith(label, "fig"))
  fig_num <- which(all_chunks == this_label)
  n <- formatC(fig_num, width = 3, flag = "0")
  new_path <- paste0(options$fig.path, n, "_")

  options$fig.path <- new_path
  return(options)
})
```




```{r}

ice_mask <- CDRv6() |>
  cdo_gtc(0.15) |>
  cdo_ymonmean() |>
  cdo_expr("'mask=aice > 0.05 ? 0 : missval(aice)'") |>
  _[]

stl_df <- function(x, years, w = 10) {
  year1 <- years[1]
  stl_decomp <- ts(x, start = c(year1, 1), frequency = 12) |>
    stl(s.window = w, t.window = 12 * w)
  list(
    anom = as.numeric(stl_decomp$time.series[, 3]),
    trend = as.numeric(stl_decomp$time.series[, 2]),
    seasonal = as.numeric(stl_decomp$time.series[, 1])
  )
}
```

```{r}
sst_t2m <- list(sst = ERA5_sst(), t2m = ERA5_t2m()) |>
  purrr::imap(\(file, name) {
    file |>
      cdo_ymonadd(ice_mask) |>
      cdo_fldmean() |>
      _[] |>
      ReadNetCDF(c(value = name)) |>
      _[, variable := name] |>
      _[]
  }) |>
  rbindlist() |>
  _[,
    c("anom", "trend", "seasonal") := stl_df(value, year(time), w = 10),
    by = variable
  ]
```


```{r}
sst_t2m |>
  copy() |>
  _[, seasonal := scale(seasonal), by = variable] |>
  ggplot(aes(time, seasonal)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = variable))
```

```{r}
sst_t2m |>
  copy() |>
  _[, anom := scale(anom + trend), by = variable] |>
  ggplot(aes(time, anom)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = variable))
```
